KaTeX 0.19.1, vendored for the typeset reading of an expression answer.

          sha512-jG8uKntjSEcm2EpQOh0XturpPuuC9r3Sq5HLHdsFdWZT27E672SF19QEi+of0/YeOy15lDgRhKvr5614uRrEfA==, was checked on the
          downloaded archive before anything was copied). No code from the package was run.
Taken:    dist/katex.min.js, dist/katex.min.css, dist/fonts/*.woff2 (20 files). Nothing else, and none edited.
          The stylesheet also names .woff and .ttf fallbacks that are not shipped; a browser that reads woff2 never asks for them.

SHA-256 of the files as stored:

Served from this origin, so the page policy needs no new source (script-src and font-src already allow 'self').
Loaded on demand by site/js/symbolic-view.js, on the cadet homework page and the staff questions page only.
The files are stored byte for byte (.gitattributes: site/vendor/** is -text); a changed byte changes the hashes above and fails
tests/app-schema/test-symbolic-view.mjs. To change the version, replace the files from the new official package and update this note.
